task.goal: Remove nondeterministic failures from the integration test suite without hiding real regressions.
task.context: The suite uses a shared temporary database and fake timers. Failures appear in parallel CI runs about 1 in 20 executions; local serial runs are green.

constraints.text: Do not skip, quarantine, or blanket-retry failing tests
Keep total CI runtime within 20 percent of the current baseline
Preserve failures that indicate a real product regression

success.text: The suite passes 100 repeated runs with parallel workers enabled
A failed run identifies the conflicting resource or clock assumption
Median CI runtime stays within 20 percent of baseline

candidates.title: Give each worker an isolated database namespace
candidates.summary: Remove cross-worker state collisions while preserving parallel execution.
candidates.mechanism: Derive a worker-specific schema or database name, create it during setup, and clean it up in teardown with the existing fixture API.
assumptions: The database supports cheap isolated namespaces
Tests already use a fixture factory
risks: A test may still reach a hard-coded shared table
validation: Add a guard against shared names

candidates.title: Inject a deterministic test clock
candidates.summary: Replace wall-clock sleeps only in timer-dependent tests while leaving production behavior unchanged.
candidates.mechanism: Pass a clock and scheduler into the affected test fixtures, advance them explicitly, and remove wall-clock sleeps from those tests; the production API and parallel worker model stay unchanged.
assumptions: The observed failures depend on timer ordering
The fixture layer can accept a clock without changing production responses
risks: A small number of unrelated asynchronous races may still need separate isolation
validation: Run the full suite under parallel workers

candidates.title: Retry every failed test once
candidates.summary: Reduce visible CI failures by repeating the failed test.
candidates.mechanism: Configure the test runner to rerun any failed test before reporting failure.
validation: Compare the green rate before and after retries

candidates.title: Increase all timeouts and sleeps
candidates.summary: Give slow CI jobs more time to settle.
candidates.mechanism: Multiply test timeouts and add delays around database cleanup.
assumptions: The failures are caused by slow machines
validation: Run the suite on the slowest CI worker

candidates.title: Run the entire suite serially
candidates.summary: Remove concurrency as a source of interference.
candidates.mechanism: Set the worker count to one for all integration tests.
risks: Parallel behavior is no longer exercised

candidates.title: Skip the known flaky cases
candidates.summary: Keep CI green by excluding the failing tests until later.
candidates.mechanism: Mark the observed tests as skipped in CI and track them in a ticket.
